[[File:Hiroshi Takase.png|200px|thumb|right|Hiroshi Takase]] '''Hiroshi Takase''' (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|嵩瀬|たかせ}}ひろし}}''' ''Takase Hiroshi'', born February 26, 1953 in {{wp|Akita (city)|Akita}})[https://web.archive.org/web/20210514140616/http://www.shin-sei.co.jp/np/search_result.html?writer_id=492 Hiroshi Takase on SHINSEI Publishing] (Japanese; archived) is a Japanese {{wp|manga artist}}. He has worked on several Pokémon quiz and puzzle {{pkmn|books}} and {{pkmn|manga}}.
